notes.title: Leafy border around the Welcome text
notes.text: Thick curving branches surround the central text column. Dense leaf-shaped forms occupy the top, while larger open loops and scattered leaves descend along both margins and curve beneath the text. LP1-03 and LP1-04 share this broad arrangement. It is distinct from the narrow single-margin branching drawings on LP2-08 through LP2-14; no plant species or cipher operation is established by the resemblance.
